messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo! "a friend" isn't gonna cut it here...

i'm tal - your talent agent who finds people actual jobs that pay. not advice, not gyaan, real interviews at companies that don't suck.

i know the bangalore tech scene inside out. which startups are dying, who's hiring, what they're really paying.

so let's start over - what's your full name?
Pulkit Barwal

pulkit barwal... solid name. got that ring to it.

where you working these days? or if you're still in college, which one?
no thats not me
I work at Navi

navi! sachin bansal's fintech play after flipkart... they're doing some solid work in the lending space. making credit accessible and all that.

found you on linkedin - prince barwal at navi. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/prince-barwal-2a46b5369

found bhavana barwal... but that's definitely not you either.

can't seem to pin you down with the usual search. drop your linkedin url or send me your resume - need something to work with here to find you the right roles.
https://www.linkedin.com/in/pulkitbarwal867

got you! navi's building some interesting stuff in the fintech space - digital lending, personal loans, that whole game. sachin's vision of making credit accessible is pretty solid.

what made you land at navi? were you already in fintech or did you make the jump from somewhere else?
what's been keeping you busy there? are you on the tech side building the lending platform, or somewhere else in the business?

lending to personalization to collections... you've basically seen the entire customer lifecycle at navi. that's actually smart - most engineers get stuck in one domain, but you're getting the full fintech stack experience.

collections is the tough side of the business - where the rubber meets the road. building systems that recover money without being too aggressive is an art.

how long you been working total? since 2023 puts you at what, about 2 years now?

2+ years across lending, personalization, and collections... that's solid domain exposure for someone early in their career. most people at your stage are still figuring out one team.

what kind of role you looking for next? staying in fintech engineering, or thinking about exploring something different?

makes sense - fintech gives you good fundamentals but exploring other domains keeps things interesting. could be edtech, gaming, ecommerce, saas... plenty of options for someone with your backend experience.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?

2+ years full stack experience + open to different domains + bangalore/remote ✅

YOOOOO welcome to the tal fam! 🎉

you're officially in the system. when roles drop that match your vibe - full stack positions, good companies, proper compensation - they'll slide right into this chat.

navi's been a solid training ground but there's a whole world of startups and scale-ups out there looking for someone with your cross-team experience. collections, lending, personalization... that's the kind of diverse background that makes you interesting.

keep doing your thing at navi. when something better comes along, you'll be the first to know 🔥
sounds great

perfect. now go crush it at navi while i work my magic behind the scenes.

when something good drops, you'll know 👊
